years_data.scenario_note: GATE 2027 has not happened (current date: Aug 2026). This row is NOT a forecast — it's a deliberate what-if, assuming the paper is at least as hard as 2024 (the hardest real year on record). Anchors reuse 2024's exact real curve as the 'at par' baseline; if 2027 turns out harder than that, actual ranks at the same marks would trend even better (lower AIR) than shown here, since a harder paper compresses the field further below the same raw score.
